text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the officer, Haiku the doctor, Gemma the citizen, Sol the citizen, Luna the killer, Terra the killer.

Six players sat down: Sonnet (officer), Haiku (doctor), Gemma and Sol (citizens), and Luna and Terra (killers). On day one Haiku pushed Sol, and the town turned on Haiku instead, voting out the doctor. Sonnet, the officer, had identified Terra, but was killed on night two before the vote could use it. Day two the town correctly voted out Terra, but Luna went unnoticed, and the killers took Gemma on night three, leaving Sol against Luna. The killers won.
